target: forge.sh pr-state — URLs whose authority is disguised (fragment-@, backslash-@, userinfo, trailing-dot host) are UNKNOWN with no request (control: the plain configured URL makes one)
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
t() { fx_run pr-state "$2"; echo "$1=$FX_OUT rc=$FX_RC reqs=$(fx_nreq)"; }
t fragment 'https://evil.example.test#@gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7'
t backslash 'https://evil.example.test\@gitlab.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7'
t userinfo 'https://user@evil.example.test/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7'
t trailingdot 'https://gitlab.example.test./grp/proj/-/merge_requests/7'
echo "requests_before=$(fx_nreq)"
t control "$U"
fx_reqs
fx_done
